exchange_security_event.mechanism_as_reported_by_binance: Unauthorized access to an internal wallet-signing service and EIP-7702 delegated authorization; Binance described a multi-stage compromise involving social engineering, malicious software, compromised endpoints and internal AI tooling. Binance stated it had no evidence wallet private keys were leaked.

recovery_and_coverage.binance_oct31_recovery_update_3: 90% replenished at that update; BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC described as 100% backed.
recovery_and_coverage.binance_nov3_initial_report: 98% of impacted token assets replenished as of Oct 31; approximately $2.85B frozen or intercepted.
recovery_and_coverage.reuters_nov18: Reported approximately 95% of lost tokens covered and approximately $3B frozen; Binance said no new fundraising was needed and declined to publish P&L, balance sheet or cash-flow statements.
recovery_and_coverage.reconciliation: The 90%, 98% and 95% statements have different publication times and potentially different denominators/scopes. Frozen/intercepted is not the same as recovered. Customer XRP 1:1 backing does not prove the original stolen XRP was recovered or quantify XRP-specific replacement purchases.

reuters_2026_11_18.boj_policy_signal: reiterated the need for further rate increases
reuters_2026_11_18.limitation: Macro context is not evidence of a causal XRP price effect.
